main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean excess 10-bar return

statistic.name: t of the weighted mean, cases of one day pooled

main_measure.threshold: above 0 with t >= 2 confirms; below 0 with t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: top-third minus bottom-third mean excess (by forecast)

decided_by: The t of the forecast-weighted mean excess lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The falling calm profile is read from the recorded regime ('unknown' = neither veto fired); grid bars without a 10-bar forward close in the window are dropped and drift is each coin's mean 10-bar grid return over all its windows; the weighted mean's t is a day-clustered standard error (per-day sums of f*(excess-mean), scaled by G/(G-1)); the thirds are floor(n/3) cases by forecast with unweighted mean excess.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +1.200 (not below 1), 73 cases (30 needed)
